verdict.rationale: Stagehand's docs position it as the tool that agents (e.g., Claude Code, CrewAI, Deep Agents) consume over MCP/stdio, not as a client that plugs in external MCP servers itself. The mcp-integrations doc explicitly states v4 'has no autonomous loop' and that the user's own orchestration layer interleaves MCP tool results with Stagehand's primitives, indicating Stagehand does not itself ingest/plug-in third-party MCP servers to gain their tools.
